notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter.
description:
Activate Staff of Domination's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, gaining you 1 life.
Heliod and Archangel of Thune triggers.
Resolve the Heliod's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creatures you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing two +1/+1 counters, adding {4}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
